summary: The `now` tool and the clock line at the top of a tagged turn now read the same clock the turn was given, so a turn replayed at a past moment hears one time everywhere.
details: It read the wall clock directly while the turn's clock line read the clock the turn was given; in an eval case frozen at a Sunday morning she called `now`, heard Monday, and told the room the plan was yesterday's.
The tag path's clock line read the wall clock too; it now reads the injected clock, as the proactive and reminder turns already did.
limitations: In production the given clock is the wall clock, so live answers are unchanged.
